children: PayPal Holdings (PYPL) is working with Meta Platforms (META) to support purchases made through Muse, Meta's personal AI agent, at participating merchants worldwide.

The arrangement brings PayPal into Meta's effort to turn Muse into a shopping tool that can handle transactions for users. The AI service is designed to act on instructions, allowing customers to move through parts of the buying process without completing each step themselves.

The deal comes as online commerce platforms test ways to connect AI assistants with payment systems. Shopify (SHOP) also said Tuesday that its merchants would be able to process purchases completed through Muse.
Amazon (AMZN), meanwhile, has blocked Muse from making purchases on its website as it seeks to restrict shopping activity carried out by outside automated services.

Meta's push into AI-led commerce follows growing attention around Muse since its recent launch. The assistant also rose to the top of Apple's U.S. App Store rankings earlier this month, pointing to early consumer interest in the product.

title: PayPal Strikes Major Meta AI Shopping Deal
